question: In a certain code language, 'BOUCLE' is coded as 'AJYSKZ'. What is the code for 'BOUDIN' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BOUCLE' is coded as 'AJYSKZ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00c5c914e8894d396c9ed3e40969123a46a3750c74085e71e2c84f691fb09d39.png] 

Similarly, for 'BOUDIN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f7c642ad4aa245c141c1e903670425a876ce39e675fd85ccfba88c5051c2789.png] 

So, 'BOUDIN' is coded as 'JGZSKZ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
